subject: Computer Networking
title: Edge Computing and the Web
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Edge Computing and the Web.

hook.text: Why send a request to a data center 5,000 miles away? Edge computing runs code close to the user.

buildup.text: Edge nodes sit in ISP facilities and CDN PoPs. They run serverless functions milliseconds from the user.

discovery.text: Cloudflare Workers run in 300+ cities. Vercel Edge Functions deploy globally. Latency drops dramatically.

twist.text: Edge has limits: small memory, short execution times, and no persistent storage. It's not a full server.

climax.text: Edge handles auth, redirects, A/B tests, and personalization. Light logic, big speed gains.

punchline.text: Edge computing: less distance, less latency, faster web.

quiz.question: What is a limitation of edge computing?
options: Small memory, short execution times, and no persistent storage
It only works in the United States

details.summary: Edge computing runs server-side code at CDN edge locations near users instead of in centralized data centers. Platforms like Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge Functions execute JavaScript and Wasm at the edge, personalizing content and reducing latency to single-digit milliseconds globally.
details.whyItMatters: Edge computing brings server-side processing close to every user worldwide. It enables personalization and dynamic content with the latency profile of a static CDN.
takeaways: Code runs at CDN edge locations near users worldwide
Response times drop to single-digit milliseconds globally
Edge functions personalize content without round-tripping to origin

faq.question: What can run at the edge?
faq.answer: Authentication checks, A/B testing, personalization, geolocation routing, URL rewriting, and lightweight API endpoints all suit edge execution. Functions run in V8 isolates or Wasm for fast cold starts. Full database queries or long-running computations still need centralized servers.

faq.question: How is edge computing different from serverless?
faq.answer: Serverless functions run in a few cloud regions. Edge functions run at hundreds of locations worldwide. Edge functions have stricter resource limits and shorter execution times but provide dramatically lower latency.
